messages.text: Taylor and Lewis suffer five straight defeats on Modus Super Series return

metadata.summary: Phil 'The Power' Taylor and Adrian Lewis suffered five losses from five matches for England at Thursday's Modus Super Series International Pairs Tournament in Portsmouth.
metadata.content: Phil Taylor and Adrian Lewis suffer five straight defeats at Modus Super Series International Pairs | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Phil Taylor and Adrian Lewis suffer five straight defeats at Modus Super Series International Pairs Phil Taylor came out of retirement to partner Adrian Lewis for England at Thursday's Modus Super Series International Pairs Tournament in Portsmouth, but the duo endured a disappointing return, losing all five of their matches; Taylor retired from professional darts in 2018 Thursday 26 November 2026 19:03, UK Image: Phil Taylor (left) and Adrian Lewis suffered defeat in all five matches they played in Thursday's Modus Super Series International Pairs Tournament Phil 'The Power' Taylor and Adrian Lewis suffered five losses from five matches for England at Thursday's Modus Super Series International Pairs Tournament in Portsmouth. Taylor, now 66, retired from the competitive circuit in 2018, five years after claiming his 16th and final world title. However, the 16-time world champion returned to action to partner his long-time friend Lewis for the tournament. Their opening match on Thursday saw them face Scotland's John Henderson and Robert Thornton, with the England pair suffering a narrow 4-3 defeat. Things failed to improve in their second outing, as Taylor and Lewis were beaten 4-2 by Sweden's Andreas Harrysson and Anton Ostlund.
